rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to say that someone reassures another person.

example.english: Having you help really does reassure me.
example.traditional: 有你幫手，真係令我放心。
example.jyutping: jau5 nei5 bong1 sau2 zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 fong3 sam1

rows.note: Use this when directly telling a worried person not to worry.

example.english: I’m saying this to reassure you: I’ll handle it.
example.jyutping: fong3 sam1 laa1 gin6 si6 gaau1 bei2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this when reassurance mainly involves comforting someone who is distressed or afraid.

example.english: They were scared, so I stayed beside them to reassure them.
example.traditional: 佢好驚，我喺旁邊安慰佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 geng1 ngo5 hai2 pong4 bin1 on1 wai3 keoi5
